# SGP4 Orbital Propagator & Ephemeris Simulation

High-precision satellite orbit propagation implementing the Simplified General Perturbations-4 (SGP4) mathematical model.

## Features
- SGP4 orbital propagation from Two-Line Element (TLE) sets
- Keplerian orbital elements calculation
- High-rate satellite state vector simulation (ECI position and velocity)

## Capabilities
- SGP4 orbital propagation
- Satellite ephemeris trajectory simulation
- Two-Line Element (TLE) parsing
